question: Should `litellm-api-key` interactive onboarding grow a LiteLLM-specific proxy URL and model-selection flow, or should remote LiteLLM proxy users be routed to Custom Provider and the broader dynamic-catalog work?
rationale: Both paths can address the user problem, but they set different provider-owned setup UX, endpoint probing, and credentialed catalog-discovery boundaries.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have LiteLLM interactive onboarding ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while preserving the existing non-interactive `--custom-base-url` path.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep `litellm-api-key` as localhost/default-model setup and update prompts/docs so remote proxy users choose Custom Provider for URL and model setup.

options.title: Defer To Dynamic Catalog
options.body: Leave this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/74481 settles credentialed `/v1/models` discovery, picker merge behavior, and cache policy.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have LiteLLM interactive onboarding ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while preserving the existing non-interactive `--custom-base-url` path.

likelyOwner.reason: He carried the LiteLLM pluginization and the closest provider-onboarding refactor history.
